about: Makers named on non-Met labels, matched to Wikidata by hand on 2026-10-04 (#42). A name search is entity resolution, so every match was checked against the label's own nationality and dates, and the ones that could not be matched are recorded as such rather than guessed. Met makers come with the Met's own Wikidata link and are not listed here.
